reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of default configurator hierarchy data. The 14 visible group/section names are editable authored configuration labels, not fixed interface chrome, so their translation ownership is deferred; schema and structural values are excluded.
limitations: Inventory only; hierarchy defaults and locale resources remain unchanged.
The owning product/content workflow must decide whether localized defaults create separate per-locale configuration values or use resource-backed defaults.
